faqs.question: How do we book our date?
faqs.answer: Send an inquiry with your dates and venue. We'll set up a short call, then a 30% advance and a simple agreement secure your date. The balance is due a week before the first event.

faqs.question: When will we receive our film and photos?
faqs.answer: A sneak-peek set of photos within 72 hours, the teaser within 2 weeks, the full photo gallery in 4 weeks and the cinematic film in 6–8 weeks.

faqs.question: Do you travel for destination weddings?
faqs.answer: Yes — we've filmed across Pakistan and abroad. Travel and stay are quoted at cost, with no hidden markup.

faqs.question: Can we customise a package?
faqs.answer: Always. Add an extra event, a pre-wedding shoot, drone, an extra album or a same-day edit — tell us what matters most and we'll shape it around you.
